name: Knex.js
solves: Provides a batteries-included SQL query builder for Node.js with transactions, migrations, seeders, and support for PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite, MSSQL, and others — without imposing a full ORM model layer.
best_for: Teams that want SQL query building + migrations without an ORM identity map
Multi-dialect Node services needing portable query builder APIs
Legacy apps standardized on Knex migrations and seeds
Projects that find ORMs too heavy but want more than a raw driver
skip_when: You want end-to-end generated types from schema — Prisma/Kysely/Drizzle are stronger
You need a full ORM with relations and unit-of-work (TypeORM/Sequelize)
You prefer Kysely's TypeScript-first query builder for new greenfield work
A single-database postgres.js client is enough
